mechanism: Chlorpromazine may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of captopril through alpha-adrenergic antagonism and direct vasodilation effects, while captopril may potentiate chlorpromazine's orthostatic hypotension; both drugs can cause hypotension and affect renal perfusion.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for orthostatic hypotension and dizziness, and consider dose adjustments or alternative antipsychotic if hypotension becomes problematic; ensure adequate hydration and patient education on position changes.
